policy: Reject sustained loops: eight consecutive decisions that close a repeated no-pellet cycle, or more than 128 consecutive decisions without a pellet. Keep every shorter repeat visible. Pellet progress, a non-cycle decision or a new life resets the loop streak. The user chose this criterion after the archived v2 strict suite rejected one brief repeat in 20 otherwise death-free clears. The teacher remains unchanged; v3 uses fresh unseen qualification seeds. Do not change these criteria after viewing v3 results. Failed gates block dataset creation. Passing is finite-suite evidence, not a universal guarantee.
seed_partition: Development, current and retired qualification seeds stay out of training. Student benchmark seeds are reserved separately. Fresh qualification occurs only after the teacher and criteria are fixed.
